candidateEngine: Direct fn-pointer static-native classifier; in-place mutating leaf probes (Map.set); String.prototype named loads behind a dictionary-layout CacheIR guard; dictionary id bump on in-place redefinition; string OOB index prototype lookup; rope-flatten rooting.
runOrder: Per tier: pairs 1 and 3 before->after, pair 2 after->before. No builds, tests or agents ran during the series.
aggregation: Geometric mean of after/before wall-median ratios across three pairs; same for process instructions and cycles.
interpreterControl: An immediately following Interpreter-only three-pair control (interp-control/) measured +0.12% wall, +0.002% instructions, -0.006% cycles; the closed series' +2.00% Interpreter wall comes from one pair-2 outlier (362.5 ms) with identical instruction counts.

excludedSeries.pilot: cand1 (classifier + Map.set) and cand2 (+ String loads, before the dictionary-id and rope fixes) single runs; cand2 ran under load average 26 from external processes and its wall times are void. Instruction counts: Production 30.29G -> 19.42G -> 11.21G, Template 28.97G -> 18.28G -> 10.71G. Not scored.
